text: Generalized coherent/configuration sufficient statistics to rectangular effect forms. The same streamed feature reads now retain separately named left and right first-moment arrays and frame mass; coherent contraction is the ordered edge-weighted outer(u_left,u_right)/mass form, and component-aware query lowering computes configuration as direct total Wq minus the direct bilinear first-moment correction. The packed self helper now delegates to the same ordered primitive and remains differential-oracle exact. Added centered-feature, singleton-zero, direct-vs-late, query/result-access, first-moment-only, self-compatibility, and conservative two-side memory tests. Full testthat suite: 927 assertions. Final source tarball built with vignettes; R CMD check --as-cran exited 0 with only the new-submission/version and local outdated HTML Tidy NOTEs. git diff --check clean.
